result.summary: The interface is functional but exhibits minor polish issues regarding asset quality and layout refinement.

issues.description: Generic vector illustrations look like placeholders, reducing the app's professional feel.
issues.suggestion: Replace basic illustrations with high-quality restaurant photography.

issues.description: Restaurant titles in the horizontal scroll section are truncated abruptly.
issues.suggestion: Increase card width or implement ellipsis for truncated text labels.

issues.description: Horizontal scrolling sections cut off sharply at the screen edge without visual cues.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle gradient fade to the right edge to indicate more content.
